summary: Frontend-only testing of the new Product Detail page (/products/:slug) with clickable image gallery. Verified card links on /products, thumb counts per product (hip-flask 5, coconut-stirrer 5, stamp 6, personalized-coconut 1 with no thumb row), main image swap on thumbnail click, active thumbnail highlight, WhatsApp deep link, back navigation, customize link, and 'product not found' state for unknown slug. All 24 checks passed.
critical_code_review_comments: ProductDetail.jsx uses `key={g}` for thumb buttons; if a product ever repeats the same URL in gallery, React will warn. Consider `key={`${slug}-${i}`}`.
Header/Footer are imported inside ProductDetail while App already renders header on root routes — current pattern is per-page (consistent with other components), no change needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Product detail gallery feature works end-to-end. Data-testids in use: product-card-link-<slug>, product-view-details-<slug>, product-detail-<slug>, product-detail-main-image, product-detail-thumbs, product-detail-thumb-<i>, product-detail-whatsapp, product-detail-back, product-not-found.
